question: What is the meaning of material usage in relation to performance information?
description: Material usage in relation to performance information refers to how the materials used in a building or construction project impact its overall performance. This includes understanding the quality, durability, and aesthetics of the materials and products applied, as well as their circularity level. By documenting and analyzing material properties, dimensions, locations, and circularity, it becomes possible to evaluate the financial implications of a building's material stock and demonstrate the value preservation through circular design choices. Additionally, continuous material documentation over time can lower barriers for direct re-use of materials and provide insights into how material choices affect building performance in terms of parameters like CO2 emissions. This approach aims to optimize material utility and value, reduce waste, and contribute to a more sustainable and resilient economy.
